integrity: The mathematical finite-state proof is algorithmically exhaustive for the specified finite universe; the source-comparison judgment is provisional in view of possible less-indexed results. No historical priority or external certification is claimed.
limitations: One initial seed; one prophylactically vaccinated vertex; one infectious round; independent contact trials and fixed directed graph. The theorem concerns individual collateral infection risk, not societal net vaccine effects. No independent replication or audit.
title: Six people are sharp for vaccine-induced collateral infection in a time-varying SIR network
